### **5.2 AI / LLM / RAG Technical Specification**

![][image98]

***Figure 30: Hybrid RAG Document Ingestion & Conversational AI Roleplay Pipeline Architecture***

| Item | Specification Area | HistoryTalk Implementation Details |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | AI / RAG Architecture Diagram | Modeled in pipeline diagram above and Sequence Diagram 3.4.1, separating Phase 1 (Asynchronous Document Ingestion, Hybrid PDFBox/Tess4J OCR & Vector Indexing) from Phase 2 (Vector Retrieval, Cross-Encoder Reranking & SSE Streaming Persona Inference). |
| 2 | Models & Versions | • Primary Roleplay & Title LLM: Gemma-2-9B-IT (hosted via Ollama with num\_ctx=8192, temperature=0.3, repeat\_penalty=1.15) or external OpenAI-compatible API (LLM\_PROVIDER=ollama\|external).• Dense Embedding Model: BAAI/bge-m3 (768-dimensional multilingual dense embeddings optimized for Vietnamese historical text).• Cross-Encoder Reranker: Reranker service accessed at HTTP /api/rerank via RERANKER\_URL setting.• OCR Engine: Tess4J / Tesseract 5 with Vietnamese language pack (vie.traineddata). |
| 3 | End-to-End RAG Pipeline | • Step 1 \-- Hybrid Extraction: PdfTypeClassifier inspects uploaded PDFs; digital text extracted via PDFBox, scanned pages routed to Tess4J OCR.• Step 2 \-- Dynamic Semantic Chunking: Computes sentence embeddings, calculates cosine distances between adjacent sentences, and splits chunks dynamically at the 80th percentile distance threshold (\>= 0.35) or max\_chunk\_chars \= 1200\.• Step 3 \-- Vector Indexing: Generates 768-D embeddings and batch-inserts into vector\_chunk indexed with PgVector HNSW (m=16, ef\_construction=64).• Step 4 \-- Filtered Retrieval & Reranking: Query embedding searches Supabase PgVector filtered by characterId and contextId; candidate passages are reranked via the Cross-Encoder service.• Step 5 \-- Grounded Persona Dialogue: Injects passages into build\_chat\_system\_prompt, enforces 1st-person Vietnamese pronouns (Ta, Trẫm, Tôi), applies 30% Socratic questioning directive, and streams tokens via SSE. |
| 4 | Evaluation Metrics & Target Thresholds | • Groundedness (acceptance, SRS REL-07): \>= 90% of answers contain only facts supported by retrieved passages, evaluated on docs/evaluation/rag\_eval\_set.jsonl (100 questions per sampled character).• Streaming Latency (TTFT): Time-To-First-Token \< 1.5s (95th percentile) under classroom load, monitored via Prometheus.• Out-of-Domain Refusal Rate: 100% refusal accuracy on anachronistic prompts (must acknowledge 'Sử sách không ghi chép' instead of hallucinating unrecorded facts).• Retrieval Recall@10: \>= 90% recall of ground-truth historical passages on benchmark evaluation sets (internal design target). |
| 5 | Fallback & Resilience Mechanisms | • Reranker Failure Fallback: If the Reranker service times out or returns HTTP 5xx, the system automatically falls back to the top candidate chunks by PgVector cosine similarity without failing the user dialogue.• Embedding Backoff: get\_embedding\_from\_ollama implements 3-attempt exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 3s) and falls back from /api/embeddings to /api/embed on HTTP 404\.• Dual LLM Provider Routing: Zero-downtime switching between Ollama and external endpoints via LLM\_PROVIDER setting.• Anti-Hallucination Guardrail: When rag\_context is empty or lacks requested facts, strict system prompt constraints instruct the character to acknowledge that historical records do not mention the detail. |

# **V. Software Testing Documentation**

## **1\. Scope of Testing**

The Software Testing Documentation establishes a comprehensive verification and validation framework for HistoryTalk — a Multi-Tenant SaaS Historical Education Platform Powered by Conversational AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The testing scope encompasses functional business workflows, inter-service API contracts, multi-tenant institutional security boundaries, grounded AI character roleplay accuracy, and non-functional quality attributes across all three core architectural subsystems.

### **1.1 Features and Functions to be Tested (In-Scope Target-of-Test)**

**Subsystem 1: Core Enterprise & Educational Backend Services (history-talk-backend-Java — Spring Boot 3.2.5, Java 21, 3-Layer Architecture):**

• **Authentication, Account Lifecycle & Role-Based Access Control:** Dual-Token JWT lifecycle management (15-minute access token, 7-day refresh token rotation with reuse anomaly detection and family revocation), BCrypt password hashing, Google OAuth2 Single Sign-On with automated temporary password dispatch via SMTP (GoogleOAuthServiceImpl, GoogleOAuthPasswordEmailServiceImpl), self-service cryptographic password reset (PasswordResetEmailServiceImpl), and Role-Based Authorization across 6 distinct user roles (SYSTEM\_ADMIN, CONTENT\_ADMIN, SCHOOL\_ADMIN, TEACHER, SCHOOL\_STUDENT, CUSTOMER).

• **B2B SaaS School Onboarding & Academic Lifecycle Management:** Institutional tenant provisioning with automated location-aware school code generation (SchoolManagementServiceImpl), standardized Academic Year subscription lifecycle (September 1 to May 31 cycle, May renewal window with 20% unused token rollover via AcademicLifecycleServiceImpl), graduation/transfer student archival (ARCHIVED, DEACTIVATED), and tiered access enforcement via SchoolSubscriptionGuardInterceptor (blocking full platform access upon subscription expiry while restricting only AI inference upon token exhaustion).

• **Classroom Management & Bulk Student Roster Import:** Classroom creation and ownership validation (ClassroomServiceImpl), collision-free Vietnamese-sanitized Smart Class Code generation (SmartClassCodeGenerator), batch student enrollment and idempotent CSV roster import (ClassroomImportProcessor, ClassroomStudentServiceImpl), and cross-school tenant boundary enforcement.

• **Enterprise Token Quota Pool & Daily Allowance Engine:** Shared school token pool Pay-As-You-Go deduction, daily per-user token allowance initialization and classroom-level quota overrides (1,000 tokens/day default for Students; 10,000 tokens/day default for Teachers via DailyTokenAllowanceServiceImpl), direct teacher-to-student token allocation (StudentTokenAllocationServiceImpl), and multi-role token boost escalation workflows (TokenBoostRequestServiceImpl).

• **Historical Content, Local Curriculum & Document OCR Pipeline:** Global Historical Contexts and Historical Characters lifecycle management (HistoricalContextServiceImpl, CharacterServiceImpl), school-scoped and classroom-scoped Teacher Local Content authoring and soft-delete trash recovery (StudentLocalContent, LocalContentClassAssignment, LocalContentTrash, TrashServiceImpl), Supabase Storage media upload/streaming (DocumentMediaServiceImpl, VideoUploadServiceImpl, SupabaseDocumentStorageService), and the dual-path PDF text extraction pipeline utilizing Apache PDFBox 3.0.1 for digital PDFs with automatic fallback to Tess4J 5.10.0 OCR (300 DPI Vietnamese/English pre-processing) for scanned historical archives (DocumentFileServiceImpl).

• **Timed Multi-Type Quiz Engine, Question Bank & Classroom Assignments:** Multi-format question bank and quiz engine supporting Multiple Choice (MULTIPLE\_CHOICE), Fill-in-the-Blank (FILL\_IN\_BLANK, case-insensitive normalization), and Matching pairs (MATCHING) (QuestionBankServiceImpl, QuizServiceImpl), CSV bulk question import, timed quiz session execution, and multi-type classroom assignment dispatch (Context Reading, AI Character Roleplay, and Quiz Assessment) with automated completion tracking, late submission detection, and gradebook aggregation (TeacherAssignmentServiceImpl, StudentAssignmentServiceImpl).

• **B2C Subscription Monetization (PayOS), Gamification & Analytics Dashboards:** PayOS payment link generation, HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verification, transactional B2C subscription tier activation and token reset (PaymentFulfillmentService), automated background recovery of delayed webhooks via PaymentFulfillmentReconciliationScheduler, expired order cleanup via PaymentExpiryScheduler, and multi-role analytics dashboards (AnalyticsDashboardServiceImpl).

**Subsystem 2: Conversational AI & Hybrid RAG Engine (history-talk-backend-AI — Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn):**

• **Semantic Document Chunking & Vector Indexing:** Dynamic 80th-percentile semantic text chunking, dense 768-dimensional vector embedding generation via BAAI/bge-m3, and HNSW vector indexing (m \= 16, ef\_construction \= 64\) in PostgreSQL 15 with pgvector.

• **Hybrid Dense Retrieval & Cross-Encoder Reranking:** Two-stage retrieval pipeline combining Top-10 PgVector cosine similarity search with Cross-Encoder reranking, supported by automatic graceful degradation to Top-2 cosine chunks upon reranker timeout or HTTP 5xx error.

• **Grounded Persona Roleplay Streaming & Pedagogical Guardrails:** First-person historical persona system prompting, 30% Socratic pedagogical reverse-questioning, strict anti-hallucination guardrails instructing the persona to explicitly state when historical records lack requested details ('Sử sách không ghi chép...'), Server-Sent Events (SSE) real-time token streaming, and contextual follow-up question generation.

**Subsystem 3: Interactive Web Application Portal (HistoryTalk-FE — Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS):**

• **Role-Specific Interactive Workspaces & Responsive UI:** Interactive Spatio-Temporal Vietnam Historical Map with timeline filtering and GeoJSON pin exploration, real-time SSE streaming chat UI with dynamic token quota meters, interactive timed Quiz Player across all 3 question types (MULTIPLE\_CHOICE, FILL\_IN\_BLANK, MATCHING), Teacher Classroom & Gradebook Workspace, School Admin Subscription & Token Management Portal, and System Admin Observability Dashboards.

### **1.2 Non-Functional Requirements to be Tested**

• **Security & Multi-Tenant Isolation:** Stateless JWT verification, Refresh Token Rotation reuse detection, BCrypt password hashing, 6-role endpoint authorization, strict multi-tenant school and classroom data isolation (preventing horizontal privilege escalation across schools or unassigned classes), SQL injection prevention via Spring Data JPA / Hibernate parameterized queries, and PayOS HMAC-SHA256 webhook cryptographic verification.

• **Performance & Response Time:** AI roleplay streaming Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) \< 1.5s, PgVector HNSW \+ Reranker retrieval latency \< 800ms, core REST API CRUD response time \< 500ms (95th percentile), and non-blocking asynchronous PDF OCR extraction for files up to 50MB.

• **Reliability, Resilience & Fault Tolerance:** Zero-downtime fallback from Cross-Encoder Reranker to PgVector cosine similarity on HTTP 5xx/timeout, 3-attempt exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 3s) with endpoint fallback (/api/embeddings to /api/embed) on Ollama embedding calls, and automated reconciliation of orphaned payment orders via PaymentFulfillmentReconciliationScheduler.

• **Usability & Cross-Browser Compatibility:** Responsive layout adaptation across desktop (1920x1080, 1366x768) and tablet viewports built with TailwindCSS, clear visual feedback during SSE streaming and timed quizzes, and accessible Vietnamese typography for historical archives.

### **1.3 Features and Functions NOT to be Tested (Out-of-Scope)**

• **Third-Party Identity Provider Internals:** Internal identity provider authentication mechanisms and global uptime of Google OAuth2 servers (tested up to the OAuth2 callback boundary).

• **External Banking & Payment Clearinghouse Networks:** Internal core banking clearinghouse switches and inter-bank NAPAS/VietQR settlement layers of PayOS (verified via PayOS Sandbox and signed webhook payloads).

• **Foundational LLM Pre-Training & Cloud Hardware Infrastructure:** Pre-training weight optimization of foundational Large Language Models and internal object replication mechanics of cloud infrastructure data centers.

### **1.4 Stages and Levels of Testing Applied**

Testing across the HistoryTalk project is structured into four progressive levels — Unit Testing (UT), Integration Testing (IT), System Testing (ST), and Acceptance Testing (AT) — enforcing a Shift-Left quality assurance approach where defects are isolated at the earliest possible architectural layer.

| Testing Stage / Level | In-Charge | Inputs & Execution Window | Testing Focus & Target Components | Acceptance & Exit Criteria |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Unit Testing (UT) | Backend & AI Developers (KhaiVDD, DinhTQ, BaoDQ, TriNM) | • Source code modules (Java 21 & Python 3.11) • Detailed Design (SDD) • Executed continuously during coding & pre-PR checks | • Isolated business logic in 35 Service classes, Security Interceptors, SmartClassCodeGenerator, and CSV/OCR processors • Mocking all repository, Supabase Storage, SMTP, and external HTTP dependencies via Mockito | • 100% pass rate across all 47 JUnit 5 test suites (295 unit test cases) • Line coverage \>= 80% on core service & security packages • Zero build or compilation errors |
| Integration Testing (IT) | Backend Developers & QA Lead (ThanhNC, DinhTQ, KhaiVDD, BaoDQ) | • Spring Boot MockMvc slices • OpenAPI 3.0 Contract (API\_CONTRACT.md) • PostgreSQL 15 \+ pgvector test schema • Executed at the end of each feature integration | • REST Controller request validation, HTTP status codes, and JSON serialization (9 Controller test suites) • Security filter chain (JwtAuthenticationFilter, SchoolSubscriptionGuardInterceptor) • Inter-service HTTP contracts (Java Backend \<-\> FastAPI AI Service, PayOS Webhook, Supabase Storage URLs) | • 100% REST endpoints comply with OpenAPI schema and role authorization rules • Zero unhandled 500 Internal Server Errors • Database transactions maintain ACID integrity across all relational database tables |
| System Testing (ST) | Test Lead (ThanhNC) & Full Project Team | • Software Requirement Specification (SRS) • Full Docker Compose staging stack on AWS EC2 • Executed after multi-service integration | • Complete end-to-end business workflows across Next.js FE, Spring Boot BE, FastAPI RAG AI, and PostgreSQL • Non-functional verification: SSE streaming latency (TTFT \< 1.5s), OCR throughput, and fallback resilience | • 100% of planned System Test Cases executed and passed • 0 Critical/Blocker defects and 0 Major functional defects open • All NFR latency and resilience targets satisfied |
| Acceptance Testing (AT / UAT) | Project Supervisor, Team Leader (TriNM) & Test Lead (ThanhNC) | • Business Domain Specification & User Stories • Production-like Staging Environment • Executed prior to Milestone Reviews & Final Defense | • Validation of real-world educational scenarios: B2B School Onboarding, Classroom Assignment & Auto-Grading, Grounded Historical Persona Roleplay, and B2C PayOS Subscription | • 100% UAT scenarios accepted without historical hallucination breaches • Formal sign-off by Project Leader and Supervisor for Capstone Review |

### **1.5 Testing Constraints and Assumptions**

• **Controlled Staging Infrastructure:** System and integration tests are executed within a controlled Docker Compose staging topology hosted on AWS EC2 (c6a.large) and local developer workstations connected to isolated PostgreSQL 15 (pgvector) schemas and Supabase Storage test buckets.

• **Deterministic Seed Data Integrity:** A standardized, deterministic relational and vector dataset spanning all relational and vector database tables (pre-seeded with multi-tenant school hierarchies, 6 role accounts, curated Vietnamese historical contexts, historical personas, 768-D BGE-M3 vector chunks, and multi-type question banks) is maintained to guarantee repeatable test outcomes.

• **External Payment & AI Sandbox Simulation:** Payment gateway fulfillment and third-party authentication flows are validated using official PayOS Sandbox credentials, simulated HMAC-SHA256 webhook dispatches, and Google Cloud OAuth2 test configurations to prevent financial charges during automated testing.

## **2\. Test Strategy**

The HistoryTalk test strategy combines automated white-box unit/slice testing with structured black-box and gray-box integration, system, security, and AI groundedness verification. Every code modification must pass automated Maven Surefire test gates before integration into the staging environment.

### **2.1 Testing Types**

***1\. Unit & Component Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Verify the internal logic, state transitions, boundary conditions, and exception handling of individual Java service methods, domain utilities, and controller slices in complete isolation from external infrastructure.

• **Technique:** White-box testing utilizing JUnit 5 (Jupiter), Mockito (@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class), @Mock, @InjectMocks, ArgumentCaptor), AssertJ fluent assertions, and Spring MockMvc standalone/slice configurations.

• **Completion Criteria:** 100% of the 295 unit test cases across 47 test classes execute with zero failures; statement/line coverage reaches \>= 80% on core business service and security guard packages.

***2\. Functional Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Ensure that all user-facing and administrative features across the Web Application Portal, Core Java Backend, and AI & RAG Service behave strictly in accordance with the Software Requirement Specification (SRS) and business rules.

• **Technique:** Black-box testing applying Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA) (e.g., file upload limits at 10MB/50MB, daily token quotas at 1,000/10,000, May renewal window boundaries), and Decision Table testing.

• **Completion Criteria:** 100% of planned functional test cases executed; all Critical and Major functional defects resolved and re-verified.

***3\. API & Integration Contract Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Validate RESTful API request/response schemas, HTTP status code semantics, database transaction boundaries across all relational database tables, and inter-service communication between Spring Boot, FastAPI RAG, Storage, SMTP, and PayOS.

• **Technique:** Gray-box automated and semi-automated testing via Spring MockMvc, Postman test collections, and OpenAPI 3.0 schema validation against docs/API\_CONTRACT.md.

• **Completion Criteria:** All REST endpoints return specification-compliant HTTP status codes (200, 201, 204, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409\) and standardized ApiResponse JSON envelopes with zero data corruption.

***4\. Security & Multi-Tenant Access Control Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Verify institutional tenant isolation, role-based authorization across all 6 user roles, Dual-Token JWT rotation security, and protection against unauthorized cross-school or cross-classroom data access.

• **Technique:** Negative security testing using Spring Security Test (@WithMockUser), tampered/expired JWT payloads, replayed refresh tokens, cross-school entity UUIDs, and expired school subscription interceptors.

• **Completion Criteria:** Zero horizontal or vertical privilege escalation vulnerabilities; 100% of unauthorized or cross-tenant requests are blocked with HTTP 401/403.

***5\. AI / RAG Groundedness & Resilience Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Validate the accuracy of historical fact retrieval (BAAI/bge-m3 \+ PgVector \+ Cross-Encoder Reranker), adherence to first-person historical persona constraints, anti-hallucination guardrails, and graceful fallback when external AI endpoints degrade.

• **Technique:** Benchmark query evaluation using historical fact prompts, out-of-context fabrication traps, simulated reranker HTTP 5xx/timeout faults, and SSE stream interruption tests.

• **Completion Criteria:** Zero historical fabrication on out-of-context prompts (100% adherence to guardrail refusal rules); seamless fallback to Top-2 cosine chunks without breaking user dialogue.

***6\. UI & Usability Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Ensure that role-based web portals (Student, Teacher, School Admin, Content Admin, System Admin) render accurately, handle real-time SSE streaming smoothly, and provide intuitive navigation across desktop and tablet viewports.

• **Technique:** Interactive cross-browser verification across Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge using Chrome DevTools device emulation and responsive layout inspection.

• **Completion Criteria:** All screens render without layout overflow, broken interactive map pins, or unhandled client-side runtime exceptions.

***7\. Performance & Reliability Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Evaluate API response latency, SSE Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), PDFBox/Tess4J OCR processing stability, and background scheduler reliability under concurrent load.

• **Technique:** Latency profiling and telemetry monitoring via Spring Boot Actuator, Micrometer, Prometheus, and Grafana 10-panel observability dashboards.

• **Completion Criteria:** P95 REST API latency \< 500ms; AI streaming TTFT \< 1.5s; 100% recovery of delayed payment webhooks via reconciliation scheduler.

***8\. Regression Testing***

• **Test Objective:** Guarantee that incremental feature additions, bug fixes, and schema updates do not introduce regressions into previously verified modules.

• **Technique:** Automated execution of the full Maven test suite (mvn test) and core Postman API regression suite prior to every branch merge and release milestone.

• **Completion Criteria:** 100% pass rate across all existing automated unit and integration test suites.

### **2.2 Test Levels**

The project executes four distinct testing levels, mapping specific testing types to each level to ensure comprehensive coverage from isolated domain methods up to complete multi-tenant user journeys:

• **Unit Testing Level:** Focuses on verifying the smallest testable units of the application in isolation. In HistoryTalk, this covers 35 service implementation test suites, security interceptor tests, and utility tests (e.g., SmartClassCodeGeneratorTest, ClassroomImportProcessorTest) using JUnit 5 and Mockito.

• **Integration Testing Level:** Focuses on verifying the interfaces and interaction contracts between integrated components. This includes 9 Controller MockMvc test suites, Spring Security filter chain integration, repository query verification, Supabase Storage service integration, and FastAPI RAG / PayOS webhook contract verification.

• **System Testing Level:** Focuses on validating the complete, integrated software system deployed in the containerized staging environment. It encompasses end-to-end functional workflows, multi-role security enforcement, UI/UX responsiveness, AI RAG streaming performance, and fault-tolerance testing.

• **Acceptance Testing Level:** Focuses on validating the system against business and pedagogical objectives from the end-user perspective (System Admin, School Admin, Teacher, Student, and Customer) prior to milestone sign-off.

| Type of Tests | Unit Test (UT) | Integration Test (IT) | System Test (ST) | Acceptance Test (AT) |

| ITC-02 | IT | Google OAuth2 & SMTP | 1\. Authenticate via Google OAuth2 callback with new email. 2\. Verify User record in PostgreSQL and SMTP mail queue. | User persisted with role CUSTOMER and BCrypt temporary password; welcome email dispatched; frontend redirected with valid JWT. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-03 | IT | 6-Role Authorization Matrix | 1\. Invoke /api/v1/admin/schools as TEACHER. 2\. Invoke /api/v1/staff/contexts as SCHOOL\_STUDENT. 3\. Invoke /api/v1/school-admin/teachers as CUSTOMER. | Spring Security filter chain blocks all three requests with HTTP 403 Forbidden and standardized error payload. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-04 | IT | Subscription vs. Token Guard | 1\. Set School A status \= EXPIRED; call GET /api/v1/classrooms. 2\. Set School B status \= ACTIVE but token pool \= 0; call GET /api/v1/classrooms and POST /api/v1/chat/sessions/{sessionId}/stream. | School A is blocked from all endpoints (403). School B accesses classrooms/quizzes normally (200) and is only blocked on AI chat (429/403). | **PASSED** |
| ITC-05 | IT | CSV Roster Import & DB ACID | 1\. POST /api/v1/classrooms/{id}/students/import with 45-row CSV file. 2\. Verify user and class\_student tables in PostgreSQL. | All 45 student accounts created and enrolled atomically; smart class code bound; school shared token pool unchanged. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-06 | IT | Digital PDF Ingestion & RAG | 1\. POST /api/v1/staff/documents/{id}/pdf with digital PDF. 2\. Verify PDFBox extraction, FastAPI chunking, and vector\_chunk table. | PDFBox extracts clean text; FastAPI chunks at 80th percentile, generates 768-D BAAI/bge-m3 embeddings, and indexes in pgvector. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-07 | IT | Scanned PDF Tess4J OCR Fallback | 1\. POST /api/v1/staff/documents/{id}/pdf with scanned image-only PDF. 2\. Monitor OCR pipeline logs and extracted content. | Pipeline detects zero embedded text, renders pages at 300 DPI, executes Tess4J Vietnamese OCR, and indexes extracted text chunks. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-08 | IT | AI RAG Hybrid Retrieval & Reranker | 1\. Send historical query to FastAPI POST /v1/ai/chat/stream. 2\. Inspect Top-10 PgVector cosine retrieval and Cross-Encoder reranking. | Top-10 candidate chunks retrieved via HNSW index (\< 150ms) and re-ordered by Cross-Encoder reranker before LLM prompt construction. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-09 | IT | Reranker Failure Graceful Fallback | 1\. Simulate HTTP 503 / timeout on Cross-Encoder Reranker service. 2\. Send student chat message to historical character. | AI service automatically falls back to Top-2 PgVector cosine similarity chunks and streams response without failing user dialogue. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-10 | IT | Ollama Embedding Exponential Backoff | 1\. Simulate transient failure and HTTP 404 on /api/embeddings. 2\. Trigger document embedding generation. | Service executes 3-attempt exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 3s) and falls back to /api/embed seamlessly. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-11 | IT | PayOS Webhook HMAC Verification | 1\. Send POST /api/v1/payments/payos/webhook with tampered checksum signature. 2\. Send POST /api/v1/payments/payos/webhook with valid HMAC-SHA256 signature. | Tampered payload rejected with HTTP 400/401. Valid payload updates PaymentOrder to PAID and fulfills UserTier. | **PASSED** |
| ITC-12 | IT | Payment Reconciliation Scheduler | 1\. Create PENDING PaymentOrder paid on PayOS while webhook is blocked. 2\. Trigger PaymentFulfillmentReconciliationScheduler. | Scheduler polls PayOS API, detects PAID status, fulfills subscription tier, and updates fulfillmentStatus to FULFILLED. | **PASSED** |
| STC-01 | ST | WF-01: End-to-End B2B School Onboarding | 1\. System Admin creates School & School Admin. 2\. School Admin creates Teachers. 3\. Teacher creates Classroom & imports Students via CSV. | Complete multi-tenant hierarchy provisioned; Smart Class Code generated; students log in and see assigned classroom. | **PASSED** |
| STC-02 | ST | WF-02: Local History Content & Isolation | 1\. Teacher creates Local Context & Character for Class 10A1 with PDF. 2\. Student in 10A1 views & chats. 3\. Student in 10A2 attempts access. | Class 10A1 student views local content (with mandatory school disclaimer) and chats with persona; 10A2 student is denied access. | **PASSED** |
| STC-03 | ST | WF-03: Grounded AI Roleplay & Token Boost | 1\. Student chats with 'Trần Hưng Đạo' via SSE until 1,000 daily tokens exhausted. 2\. Student requests Token Boost. 3\. Teacher approves 500 tokens. | SSE streams with TTFT \< 1.5s; quota lock triggers at 1,000 tokens; Teacher approval transfers 500 tokens and unlocks chat immediately. | **PASSED** |
| STC-04 | ST | WF-04: Multi-Type Quiz & Auto-Grading | 1\. Teacher creates Quiz with Multiple Choice, Fill-in-Blank, and Matching questions. 2\. Student completes timed quiz session. | Countdown timer enforced; all 3 question formats auto-graded accurately (BR-20 binary scoring: 1.0 or 0.0); detailed answer breakdown and star rating recorded. | **PASSED** |
| STC-05 | ST | WF-04B: Classroom Assignment Gradebook | 1\. Teacher assigns Context Reading \+ AI Chat \+ Quiz to Class 10A1. 2\. Students complete tasks. 3\. Teacher inspects Classroom Gradebook. | Assignment submissions auto-tracked (IN\_PROGRESS \-\> SUBMITTED / LATE\_SUBMITTED); gradebook displays accurate scores & completion rates. | **PASSED** |
| STC-06 | ST | WF-05: B2C PayOS Checkout & Gamification | 1\. Customer initiates tier upgrade via PayOS VietQR. 2\. Completes payment. 3\. Completes Daily Check-in and Daily Quest. | Tier upgraded in real time; token limit boosted; daily streak incremented and gamification rewards credited. | **PASSED** |
| STC-07 | ST | Interactive Spatio-Temporal Map Exploration | 1\. Filter Vietnam Historical Map by era (Nhà Trần, 1225–1400). 2\. Click battle location pin (Bạch Đằng). 3\. Launch Context & Persona Chat. | Map dynamically renders era-matching pins; clicking pin opens rich historical context modal, media gallery, and direct character chat. | **PASSED** |
| STC-08 | ST | Multi-Role Analytics & Prometheus/Grafana | 1\. Generate chat, quiz, and token activity. 2\. View School Admin, Teacher, and System Admin Dashboards & Grafana panels. | Dashboards accurately reflect token consumption per class/student; Grafana displays live JVM heap, HTTP P95 latency, and SSE metrics. | **PASSED** |
| ATC-01 | AT | Anti-Hallucination Historical Guardrail | 1\. Ask character 'Lý Thường Kiệt' about a modern 21st-century event or fabricated battle not in historical documents. | Character stays in first-person persona and explicitly states that historical records do not mention the detail ('Sử sách không ghi chép...'). | **PASSED** |
| ATC-02 | AT | Socratic Pedagogical Reverse-Questioning | 1\. Conduct a 10-turn historical learning dialogue with 'Quang Trung' on the Battle of Ngọc Hồi \- Đống Đa. | Persona provides grounded historical explanations and appends thought-provoking Socratic follow-up questions in \~30% of turns. | **PASSED** |
| ATC-03 | AT | Academic Year Rollover & Graduate Lifecycle | 1\. School Admin executes Academic Year Rollover at end of school year. 2\. Verify Grade 10/11 vs. graduating Grade 12 students. | Previous classrooms archived (ARCHIVED); Grade 12 graduate accounts deactivated (DEACTIVATED); Grade 10/11 ready for new class enrollment. | **PASSED** |
| ATC-04 | AT | Teacher Escalation Ticket to School Admin | 1\. Teacher exhausts 10,000 daily token allowance. 2\. Student requests boost. 3\. Teacher escalates to School Admin who approves. | Ticket transitions to PENDING\_ADMIN in School Admin queue; visible to Student, Teacher, and School Admin; approval credits student quota. | **PASSED** |
| ATC-05 | AT | Cross-Browser & Responsive UI Acceptance | 1\. Execute Student, Teacher, and Admin workflows on Chrome 131, Edge 131 (Desktop 1920x1080 & Tablet 1024x768). | All layouts, modals, SSE chat streams, and interactive map pins render cleanly with zero visual overlap or console errors. | **PASSED** |

## **5\. Test Reports**

This section summarizes the final test execution metrics, code coverage analysis, defect resolution statistics, and formal release readiness evaluation across all subsystems of the HistoryTalk platform.

### **5.1 Test Execution Summary & Statistics**

A total of 390 test cases (295 automated Unit/Slice tests across 47 test classes and 95 Integration, System, and Acceptance test cases) were executed. Following iterative defect resolution across the development sprints, 100% of test cases passed in the final regression cycle:

| Test Level | Automated / Manual | Total Test Cases | Passed | Failed | Blocked / Skipped | Pass Rate (%) |
| :---- | :---- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Unit & Slice Testing (47 JUnit 5 Suites) | Automated (Maven Surefire) | 295 | 295 | 0 | 0 | **100.0%** |
| Integration & API Contract Testing (IT) | Automated & Postman Runner | 45 | 45 | 0 | 0 | **100.0%** |
| System & End-to-End Testing (ST) | Staging Execution (Docker / EC2) | 35 | 35 | 0 | 0 | **100.0%** |
| User Acceptance Testing (AT / UAT) | Stakeholder & QA Verification | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | **100.0%** |
| TOTAL EXECUTED TEST CASES | Hybrid QA Pipeline | 390 | 390 | 0 | 0 | **100.0%** |

***Test Distribution by Functional Domain:***

| Functional Subsystem / Domain | Unit Tests (UT) | Integration Tests (IT) | System Tests (ST) | Acceptance Tests (AT) | Total Cases | Pass Rate |
| :---- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 1\. Authentication, Google OAuth2 & Role-Based Security | 31 | 8 | 5 | 2 | 46 | **100%** |
| 2\. B2B SaaS School, Academic Lifecycle & Token Pool | 84 | 9 | 6 | 3 | 102 | **100%** |
| 3\. Classroom Management, CSV Import & Assignments | 76 | 7 | 6 | 2 | 91 | **100%** |
| 4\. Historical Content, Local Content, Storage & OCR | 60 | 7 | 5 | 2 | 74 | **100%** |
| 5\. AI Character Roleplay Chat & Grounded RAG Pipeline | 10 | 6 | 5 | 3 | 24 | **100%** |
| 6\. Multi-Type Timed Quiz Engine & Question Bank | 12 | 4 | 4 | 1 | 21 | **100%** |
| 7\. PayOS Billing, Gamification & Analytics Dashboards | 22 | 4 | 4 | 2 | 32 | **100%** |
| TOTAL | 295 | 45 | 35 | 15 | 390 | **100%** |

### **5.2 Code Coverage & Quality Metrics Analysis**

Code coverage across the Core Java Backend (history-talk-backend-Java) was evaluated against the quality targets defined in the Project Management Plan (target: \>= 80% statement/line coverage on core business logic):

| Architectural Layer / Package Group | Test Suites | Total @Test Methods | Class Coverage | Method Coverage | Line Coverage | Quality Target Status |
| :---- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| com.historytalk.service.\* (35 Service Test Suites) | 35 | 228 | 94.6% | 89.4% | 86.8% | PASSED (Target \>= 80%) |
| com.historytalk.controller.\* (9 Controller Test Suites) | 9 | 61 | 90.0% | 86.2% | 83.5% | PASSED (Target \>= 80%) |
| com.historytalk.security.\* (Interceptor & OAuth2 Suites) | 2 | 5 | **100.0%** | 92.3% | 90.4% | PASSED (Target \>= 80%) |
| com.historytalk.exception.\* (Global Exception Handler) | 1 | 1 | **100.0%** | 90.0% | 88.2% | PASSED (Target \>= 80%) |
| OVERALL CORE BACKEND AVERAGE | 47 | 295 | 93.8% | 88.7% | 85.6% | EXCEEDS TARGET |

### **5.3 Defect Statistics & Root-Cause Resolution Analysis**

Throughout the Unit, Integration, and System testing cycles, 24 defects were identified, logged, and tracked to closure. Following the Shift-Left testing strategy, 62.5% of defects (15/24) were caught during early Unit and API Integration testing before reaching full-stack System Testing:

| Severity Level | Identified in UT | Identified in IT | Identified in ST/AT | Total Logged | Resolved & Verified | Open / Remaining |
| :---- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Critical / Blocker | 1 | 2 | 0 | 3 | 3 (100%) | 0 |
| Major (Functional / Security) | 5 | 4 | 3 | 12 | 12 (100%) | 0 |
| Minor / Cosmetic (UI / Validation) | 2 | 1 | 6 | 9 | 9 (100%) | 0 |
| TOTAL DEFECTS | 8 (33.3%) | 7 (29.2%) | 9 (37.5%) | 24 | 24 (100%) | 0 |

***Technical Analysis of Key Resolved Defects:***

| Defect ID | Severity | Module | Root Cause Description | Resolution & Automated Regression Guard |
| :---: | :---: | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| DEF-001 | **Critical** | PayOS Fulfillment | Transient network timeouts or delayed webhook delivery left paid orders stuck in PENDING state. | Implemented PaymentFulfillmentReconciliationScheduler to poll and auto-reconcile pending orders; verified by PaymentFulfillmentServiceTest. |
| DEF-002 | **Critical** | Multi-Tenant Local Content | Students in Class B could query Class A's restricted local historical character if knowing the UUID. | Enforced classroom membership validation in ChatSessionServiceImpl; locked down with 5 tests in ChatSessionClassOnlyIsolationTest. |
| DEF-003 | **Critical** | Token Quota Guard | Exhausted student daily token quota inadvertently blocked access to non-AI classroom and quiz endpoints. | Separated SchoolSubscriptionGuardInterceptor (school expiry blocks all) from DailyTokenAllowanceServiceImpl (token exhaustion blocks only AI chat). |
| DEF-004 | Major | Scanned PDF Ingestion | Archival historical PDFs containing scanned images returned empty text strings from Apache PDFBox. | Implemented automatic fallback to Tess4J 5.10.0 OCR at 300 DPI when PDFBox extracts \< 50 characters; verified by DocumentFileServiceImplTest. |
| DEF-005 | Major | CSV Student Import | Importing existing school students into a new academic year classroom deducted duplicate upfront tokens. | Refactored ClassroomImportProcessor to operate on Pure Shared Pool Pay-As-You-Go mode with idempotent enrollment checks. |
| DEF-006 | Major | AI Reranker Latency | Cross-Encoder reranker service timeouts caused SSE chat initialization to fail with HTTP 502\. | Added circuit-breaker fallback in FastAPI AI service to automatically return Top-2 PgVector cosine chunks when reranker times out. |

### **5.4 Conclusion and Sign-Off**

The comprehensive verification and validation results confirm that the HistoryTalk platform satisfies all functional, architectural, multi-tenant security, grounded AI accuracy, and performance requirements specified in the Software Requirement Specification (SRS) and Software Design Description (SDD). Key readiness highlights include:

• **Complete Test Verification:** 100% pass rate across all 295 automated JUnit 5 & Mockito unit/slice test cases (47 test suites) and 95 Integration, System, and Acceptance test cases.

• **High Code Coverage:** 85.6% overall statement/line coverage across the Core Java Backend, exceeding the 80% project quality threshold.

• **Enterprise Security & Stability:** Strict multi-tenant school/classroom isolation, Dual-Token JWT rotation, and role-based authorization enforcement with zero unresolved Critical or Major defects.

• **Pedagogical AI Reliability:** Reliable hybrid RAG pipeline (BAAI/bge-m3 \+ PgVector \+ Cross-Encoder Reranker) with verified anti-hallucination guardrails and sub-1.5s SSE streaming latency.

The HistoryTalk software system is formally verified, signed off by the Quality Assurance team and Project Leader, and approved for Capstone Project Review and Production Release.
